record.question: Which city has been named as the world's most polluted city, as per recently released urban air quality database of World Health Organization (WHO)?
record.explanation: Answer D: Zabol. Zabol, Iran, had the highest annual mean PM 2.5 value in the WHO urban ambient-air database released in 2016, at 217 micrograms per cubic metre. The metric matters: a PM 10 ranking in the same data had a different leader. D is supported for the PM 2.5 ranking behind the contemporary headline. Historical/source note: WHO database released in 2016, annual mean PM 2.5 among cities with available monitoring data; not a universal/current ranking across all pollutants. Reference: https://www.unicef.org/media/49966/file/UNICEF_Clear_the_Air_for_Children_30_Oct_2016.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial.
